how: We read the website of every Raleigh-Durham wedding planner listed on Lazo (83 listings, 71 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a wedding magazine, an officiant team, a florist and a decor rental company that were listed as planners, and a generic events-and-travel consultancy. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Full planning, partial, or day-of only? Ask what each tier includes in hours and in meetings.
Which Triangle venues and vendors have you worked with this year? Local relationships are the job.
If my outdoor ceremony is in June or September, what is your heat and rain protocol on the day?

picks.name: Gina Myers Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Since 2010, Gina Myers, formerly La Cosa Bella Events, has specialized in high-touch planning for discerning, professional couples, with more than 15 years in weddings. Raleigh and destination, with the full-service tier described step by step on the site.

picks.name: Harmony Weddings and Events
picks.blurb: A Raleigh team of more than 20 planners and assistants, with seven lead planners who work directly with couples on partial and full-service planning. The owner was born and raised in North Carolina and, as a child, planned her own elaborate birthday parties with invitations, a timeline and decor.

picks.name: A Swanky Affair
picks.blurb: Amanda has spent 20 years in the events industry and has coordinated or planned nearly 300 weddings since opening A Swanky Affair in Durham. Featured on Style Me Pretty and The Knot, with planning and coordination for Durham and Chapel Hill couples.

picks.name: Sally Oakley Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Sally Oakley opened her Raleigh planning company in 2010 to make wedding planning less stressful and more fun, and the team has since lightened the load for over 500 couples. Packages run from event management to partial planning and can be customized.

picks.name: Lauren O & Co.
picks.blurb: Lauren O brings over 13 years of wedding planning and pitches herself as real, relatable and remarkably efficient, for modern couples who want a celebration with lasting impact. Raleigh and destination, with a stated commitment to building up the vendor community she works with.

picks.name: Shawn Schindler Events
picks.blurb: Shawn Schindler is a North Carolina native with more than 25 years producing weddings, social celebrations and corporate events across the Triangle and the Carolinas. The Raleigh team offers tailored experiences from simple elegance to spectacular, for ballrooms, shorelines and backyards alike.

picks.name: Elizabeth Flake Events
picks.blurb: Formerly A Southern Soirée, Elizabeth Flake Events is a Durham team of hospitality experts specializing in tented and destination celebrations, rooted in the Southern tradition of gathering. Planning since 2010, with precision planning, distinguished design and guest experience as the three pillars.

picks.name: Anthem House Event Planning
picks.blurb: Formerly C&D Events and now part of the JACKS Hospitality family, Anthem House plans luxury weddings across Raleigh and all of North Carolina with coordination and bespoke design built around each couple's story. Based in New Hill.

picks.name: Kast Events & CO
picks.blurb: Cheryl-Anne trained in culinary arts, joined the Fearrington House team as a party chef in 2006 and moved onto its wedding and events team before opening Kast Events, a planning and design studio in Pittsboro. Custom, one-of-a-kind weddings in Chapel Hill and across North Carolina.

picks.name: Timeless Love Weddings and Events
picks.blurb: Timeless Love Weddings offers full planning, partial planning and day-of coordination from Clayton, Raleigh-based and available throughout North Carolina. The specialty is luxe, timeless design, from elegant traditional weddings to luxurious South Asian weddings.

picks.name: Moonshine Micro Weddings
picks.blurb: Moonshine exists, in its own words, to throw a wrench in the wedding industry so couples can show up without performing. Gabriella planned a micro wedding a decade ago, before anyone called it that, and started as an officiant in California writing ceremonies that sound like the couple. A small Raleigh team of planners and designers.

picks.name: Events by Emily, LLC
picks.blurb: Emily leads a boutique Durham planning and design team with over 20 years of combined experience and weddings planned in North Carolina, Virginia, California, Maine, New York and South Carolina. Diversity, sustainability and inclusion shape the vendors they recommend, and they celebrate love in all forms.
